z-m-07-09.title: Isitolo sezinkwa kufanele sibhake izinkwa ezinoshokoledi lwamabhontshisi abomvu ezingaki ngoMsombuluko olandelayo?
z-m-07-09.topic: Ukucabanga okuzayo ngamarekhodi ezentengiso (ukubhekana nenani elingajwayelekile)
z-m-07-09.goal: Yazi ukuthi uma ucabanga okuzayo ngamarekhodi, ukubhekana nenani elingajwayelekile kuncike esizathweni, bese ulungisa umcabango wakho nokuthi ukholwa kangakanani ngolwazi olusha, ukubhale phansi enothini.
z-m-07-09.material: Isitolo sezinkwa sendawo sibhaka njalo ekuseni izinkwa zamabhontshisi abomvu zokuthengiswa ngalolo suku. Uma sibhaka eziningi kakhulu, ezinye ziyashiywa, futhi uma sibhaka ezimbalwa kakhulu, ziyaphela. Umnini ufuna ukunquma ukuthi abhake zingaki ngoMsombuluko olandelayo ngokubheka amarekhodi entengiso yeviki eledlule. Evikini eledlule isitolo sasivulekile nsuku zonke kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoLwesihlanu.
z-m-07-09.thinking.1: Bhekana nenani elingajwayelekile ngokuhlola isizathu salo
z-m-07-09.thinking.2: Gcina noma ulungise isinqumo sakho ngolwazi olusha
z-m-07-09.thinking.3: Sho izimo lapho umcabango wakho ungashintsha
z-m-07-09.prereq.0: Ukufunda izinombolo emathebuleni noma emarekhodini nokuhlukanisa izinombolo ezisondelene nezingajwayelekile (izinga lebanga 3)
z-m-07-09.prereq.1: Yazi izisho zokulinganisa ezifana no-'cishe' no-'nganoma'
z-m-07-09.s.s1.prompt: Ake sicabange ukuthi sibhake zingaki ngoMsombuluko olandelayo njengoba sifunda amarekhodi entengiso kancane kancane. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha lokho ocabanga ukuthi kufanelekile kakhulu.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ngokulandelana izinombolo zentengiso zezinsuku ezaziwa kuze kube manje, bese ukhomba izinombolo ezisondelene nezinombolo ezihlukile.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.1: Uma kunenombolo ehlukile, cabanga indlela yokuhlola ukuthi kukhona okunye okwenzekile ngalolo suku yini.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Zithengise ezingu-12 ngoMsombuluko, ezingu-14 ngoLwesibili, nezingu-13 ngoLwesithathu.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kungaba kuhle ukubhaka izinkwa zamabhontshisi abomvu ezingaki ngoMsombuluko olandelayo?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Izinsuku ezintathu ziyafana ku-12 kuya ku-14, ngakho cishe u-13, noma ukuphusha kancane cishe u-14, kuyafaneleka. Njengoba sibonile izinsuku ezi-3 kuphela, 'ngifuna ukubuka isikhathi eside kancane' kungacatshangwa, kodwa nawamanje amarekhodi asivumela ukusho usayizi ongaba nguwo.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokho kuningi kakhulu kunosuku olunentengiso enkulu kakhulu phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu. Bheka ukuthi amarekhodi anikeza yini isizathu sokukhuphula kangaka.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi sinqumo esikhethe maphakathi ngoba ukuthengisa kwezinsuku ezintathu kuseduze, ku-12 kuya ku-14.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi sinqumo esivumele okwengeziwe kancane ngoba ukuphela kuyisikhathi esikhulu kunokushiywa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Sibonile izinsuku ezi-3 kuphela ngakho asikwazi ukunquma
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lona ngumbono onakekile. Kodwa, ukubheka ukuthi izinombolo zezinsuku ezintathu zisondelene kangakanani kunganikeza isikhonjo.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.info: NgoLwesine zithengise ezingu-31. Umnini akakazi ukuthi kungani ezinengi kangaka zithengiswe ngoLwesine.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ukucabanga kwakho ngenani lokubhaka ngoMsombuluko olandelayo kushintsha kanjani?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi kungani u-31 uvele, kokubili 'gcina cishe u-13 bese ufuna isizathu' kanye 'nokulungiselela okungaphezulu kancane cishe u-17 kuya ku-18' kuyafaneleka. Ziyafana ngokuthi kusenesikhathi sokukholwa u-31 njengoba unjalo noma ukuwususa ngaphandle kwesisekelo.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Khuphula kuze kusondele ku-31. Yirekhodi lakamuva kakhulu
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi ukuba yakamuva kakhulu kuyisizathu sokukholwa u-31 yini. Uhluke kangakanani ezinombolweni zezinye izinsuku ezintathu?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Alukho ubufakazi bokuthi irekhodi alilungile. Kungcono ukuhlola ukuthi kungani lalikhulu kunokulisusa ngaphandle kobufakazi.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Gcina umcabango wokuqala, kodwa funa ukuthi kungani uLwesine bekungaphezulu
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo asikholwa noma sikhiphe ngokushesha inani elikude, kodwa sizama ukuthola isizathu.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Faka ndawonye zonke izinsuku ezine bese uhlukanisa ngo-4, bese ubhaka cishe u-17 kuya ku-18
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Inani elikude nalo lirekhodi, ngakho uyalifaka, kodwa leli nani likhuphula isilinganiso. Asikazi ukuthi uMsombuluko olandelayo uzoba usuku olufana noLwesine yini.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.info: NgoLwesihlanu zithengise ezingu-13. Futhi sithole ukuthi ngoLwesine kwakunomcimbi womnyaka ekupaki eseduze kanye kuphela. Akukho mcimbi eduze ngoMsombuluko olandelayo.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje, kungaba kuhle ukubhaka zingaki ngoMsombuluko olandelayo?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.after: ULwesine wawuyisuku lapho eziningi zithengisa ngenxa yomcimbi owodwa, futhi akukho mcimbi ngoMsombuluko olandelayo, ngakho ezinye izinsuku ezine (12, 14, 13, 13) ziyisiqondiso esingcono. Cishe u-13, noma cishe u-15 ngendawo encane, kuyafaneleka. Okuhlukile ukuthi noma umfundi ogcine umcabango wokuqala kuze kube sekugcineni waqiniseka kakhulu ngemva kokufunda isizathu.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kwashiwo ukuthi akukho mcimbi ngoMsombuluko olandelayo. Cabanga ukuthi isizathu sokuthi u-31 uvele sizophinda senzeke yini.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukubonise kanjani ekubaleni ukuthi uLwesine wawungesona usuku olujwayelekile kodwa usuku lomcimbi?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uma ushiya uLwesine, lapho kwakunomcimbi, ezinye izinsuku ziyafana ku-12 kuya ku-14. Lesi sinqumo esikhethe maphakathi kwalokho.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lesi sinqumo esivumele indawo encane ngokususelwa cishe ku-13.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.reflect: Ukufaka u-31 kaLwesine ekubaleni noma cha kushintsha kakhulu umcabango wakho. Sho ukuthi kungani uphathe inombolo efanayo ngokuhlukile ngaphambi nangemva kokwazi isizathu. Cabanga nokuthi into eyodwa ingaphinda yenzeke yini.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inothi kumnini. Bhala inani lokubhaka ngoMsombuluko olandelayo, isizathu sokuthi uliqonde kanjani, nesimo esisodwa lapho leli nani lingashintsha.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.0: Funda futhi izinombolo zezinsuku eziseduze noMsombuluko bese uthola ukuthi yisiphi usuku olufana kakhulu.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga usuku olulodwa lapho inombolo ingashintsha (umcimbi, isimo sezulu).
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole futhi ukuthi inombolo oyikhethile iseduze nezinombolo emarekhodini?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi uphathe kanjani u-31 kaLwesine (ukuthi uwufake noma uwushiye) nesizathu?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe 'isimo esingashintsha' osibhalile ngempela siyisimo esingashintsha inombolo?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.0: Ngingathanda ukubhaka cishe u-13. NgoMsombuluko, uLwesibili, uLwesithathu, noLwesihlanu zithengise ezingu-12 kuya ku-14, futhi u-31 kaLwesine wawuvela ngenxa yomcimbi womnyaka. Uma kukhona umcimbi eduze nangoMsombuluko, kufanele ubhake eziningi.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.1: Ngizobhaka cishe u-15. Ngokujwayelekile cishe u-13 uyathengiswa, ngakho ngengeze u-2 ukuze kube nokwengeziwe kancane, futhi ngishiye u-31 kaLwesine ngoba kwakungenxa yomcimbi owodwa. Uma kuna, ezimbalwa zingathengiswa.

z-m-07-01.title: Umphumela wenombolo yamadijithi amabili nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa uhlala uyinombolo yamadijithi amathathu?
z-m-07-01.topic: Ukunquma ukuthi umphumela we-(inombolo yamadijithi amabili)×(inombolo yedijithi eyodwa) unamadijithi amangaki
z-m-07-01.goal: Azi ukuthi izibonelo ezimbalwa zokuphindaphinda ezilungile azenzi 'njalo,' yenza wena izibonelo lapho umphumela wenombolo yamadijithi amabili nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa uyinombolo yamadijithi amabili, bese usho ukuthi iba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu nini.
z-m-07-01.material:
U-Doyun uxazulule izinkinga zokuphindaphinda futhi wathi lokhu.
'37×4=148, 52×6=312, 78×9=702. Umphumela wenombolo yamadijithi amabili nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa uhlala uyinombolo yamadijithi amathathu!'
(Lapha inombolo yamadijithi amabili iyinombolo kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-99, futhi inombolo yedijithi eyodwa iyinombolo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-9. 37×4 ifundwa 'amashumi amathathu nesikhombisa izikhathi ezine.')
z-m-07-01.thinking.0: Hlola ukuthi izibonelo eziningi ezilungile ziqinisekisa 'njalo' yini
z-m-07-01.thinking.2: Sho isilinganiso esihlukanisa lapho kusebenza khona nalapho kungasebenzi
z-m-07-01.prereq.0: Funda izisho zokuphindaphinda zenombolo yamadijithi amabili nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa bese uthola inani (izinga leBanga 3)
z-m-07-01.prereq.1: Azi ukuthi u-100 uyinombolo yokuqala yamadijithi amathathu
z-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Ucabanga ini ngalokho u-Doyun akushilo? Hlulela ngaphakathi kwamabanga amisiwe: izinombolo zamadijithi amabili ziyi-10 kuya ku-99 nezinombolo zedijithi eyodwa ziyi-2 kuya ku-9.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala eceleni komunye izinombolo u-Doyun azihloliwe, 37, 52, no-78, nezinombolo azifaka, 4, 6, no-9, bese uthola ukuthi yimaphi amacala angawahloli.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Phindaphinda izinombolo ezimbili ezincane kakhulu ebangeni nezinombolo ezimbili ezinkulu kakhulu, bese ulinganisela ukuthi umphumela uphakathi kwebanga elingakanani.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.a: Uphindaphinde ngenombolo yedijithi eyodwa, ngakho umphumela uhlala uyinombolo yamadijithi amabili
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.a: Inombolo yamadijithi amabili ibe yisici sedijithi eyodwa ayenzi umphumela ube yinombolo yamadijithi amabili. Bheka ukuthi umphumela ka-78×9, u-Doyun awunikeze, unamadijithi amangaki.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.b: Uma inombolo yedijithi eyodwa ingu-9, umphumela uhlala uyinombolo yamadijithi amathathu
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.b: Noma ukuphindaphinda ngo-9 kungaba nenombolo yamadijithi amabili. Bheka ukuthi umphumela ka-10×9 uyini.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.c: Zonke izibonelo ezintathu zilungile, ngakho u-Doyun ulungile
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.c: Isibonelo esilungile ngokuhlukile ku-"njalo" ulungile. Udinga ukubheka ukuthi kukhona yini amacala angakahlolwa.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.d: Ngezinye izikhathi iyinombolo yamadijithi amathathu futhi ngezinye izikhathi iyinombolo yamadijithi amabili
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.d: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi inani lamadijithi omphumela lingashintsha kuye ngosayizi bezinombolo ezimbili eziphindaphindwayo. Kucaca kakhulu uma wenza izibonelo bese uhlola.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.explain: Umphumela omncane kakhulu ebangeni ngu-10×2=20 futhi omkhulu kakhulu ngu-99×9=891. Ngakho umphumela ungaba inombolo yamadijithi amabili noma yamadijithi amathathu, futhi awukwazi ukuba yinombolo yamadijithi amane.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezimbili ezinemiphumela ehlukile ezibonisa ukuthi isitatimende sika-Doyun asilungile. Khetha inombolo yamadijithi amabili a (10 kuya ku-99) nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa b (2 kuya ku-9) ukuze umphumela ungabi yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha izinombolo ezincane kuqala bese uphindaphinda, bese uhlola ukuthi umphumela unamadijithi amangaki.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha u-a oyedwa, bese ushintsha u-b ube ngu-2, 3, 4, ... bese uthola lapho umphumela uba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu okokuqala.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Yenza u-a abe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-99.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: b iyinombolo yedijithi eyodwa (2 kuya ku-9).
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Yenza u-b abe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-9.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Umphumela ungaphansi kuka-100, ngakho akuyona inombolo yamadijithi amathathu. Isitatimende sika-Doyun siyaphuka.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Umphumela uyinombolo yamadijithi amathathu noma ngaphezulu. Shintsha u-a noma u-b ukuze umphumela uncipha.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, 12×3=36, 20×4=80, no-45×2=90 zonke ziyizinombolo zamadijithi amabili. 50×2=100 iyisiqalo sezinombolo zamadijithi amathathu, ngakho akuyona isibonelo. Noma isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siphula 'njalo.'
z-m-07-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungathanda ukutshela ini u-Doyun? Usebenzisa izibonelo osanda kuzenza, bhala ukuthi kungani ephutha, futhi ubhale nokuthi umphumela uba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu nini.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ungasebenzisa izisho zokuphindaphinda ezivela ezibonelweni owazenza kuqala njengoba zinjalo.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi iyiphi inombolo engumkhawulo phakathi kwezinombolo zamadijithi amabili nezamadijithi amathathu.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Esibonelweni sakho, ingabe ubale futhi ukuhlola ukuthi umphumela wenombolo yamadijithi amabili nenombolo yedijithi eyodwa ngempela uyinombolo yamadijithi amabili?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale uzi ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa sanele ukuphula 'njalo'?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi iba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu nini ngezinombolo (isibonelo, 99×9) noma isilinganiso (100 noma ngaphezulu)?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.0: Lokho u-Doyun akushilo akulungile njalo. Kunamacala lapho iyinombolo yamadijithi amabili, njengo-12×3=36. Uma izinombolo ezimbili zinkulu futhi umphumela udlula u-100, iba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.1: Cha. 20×4=80 iyinombolo yamadijithi amabili. Uma izinombolo ezimbili eziphindaphindwayo zikhulu, umphumela uba mkhulu, ngakho ungaba yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu njengo-99×9=891.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo ethi 'uma izinombolo zikhulu' esikhundleni sesilinganiso '100 noma ngaphezulu' nayo ilungile.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.2: Inombolo yamadijithi amabili nayo ingaphuma, njengo-12×3=36, ngakho u-Doyun uphutha. Umphumela kumele udlule u-100 ukuze ube yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu.

z-m-07-03.title: Ngihlukanise inombolo ekhadini ngo-6 futhi inani elitholiwe bekungu-7. Inombolo ekhadini iyini?
z-m-07-03.topic: Ukuthola ibanga lesihlukaniswa kusukela enanini elitholiwe nokusele ekuhlukaniseni okunokusele
z-m-07-03.goal: Yazi ukuthi inani elitholiwe lodwa alimisi isihlukaniswa kunombolo eyodwa, khomba ulwazi olungekho (okusele), futhi uthole izinombolo eziningana ezihambisana nemibandela nenombolo enkulu kakhulu.
z-m-07-03.material: USoyul wembozile ikhadi lenombolo ngesandla sakhe futhi wathi, 'Inombolo kuleli khadi iyinombolo yemvelo. Ngiyihlukanise ngo-6 futhi inani elitholiwe bekungu-7.' USoyul akakasho ukuthi kunokusele noma cha.
z-m-07-03.prereq.0: Yazi incazelo yenani elitholiwe nokusele ekuhlukaniseni okunokusele (izinga leBanga 3)

z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale inombolo encane kakhulu enenani elitholiwe elingu-7. Yengeze u-1, 2, 3, ... kuyo futhi uhlole ukuthi inani elitholiwe lisengu-7.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala bonke abangenzeka, futhi uthole ukuthi ucezu olulodwa olwengeziwe lolwazi lungashiya yiluphi oyedwa kuphela.

z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.c: USoyul sekasitshelile isihlukanisi u-6. Okungakamiswa okwamanje kuyingxenye enye.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.d: U-42 ungomunye wabangenzeka, kodwa uma kunokusele, akusona u-42. USoyul akashongo ukuthi kuhlukaniseka ngokulinganayo.

z-m-07-06.title: Uma unamathisela onxantathu abalungile ababili abafanayo ndawonye, uhlala uthola i-rectangle?
z-m-07-06.topic: Imimumo eyenziwe ngokunamathisela onxantathu abalungile ababili abafanayo ndawonye (umumo nobude bomjikelezo)
z-m-07-06.goal: Hlola isitatimende esithi 'njalo' ngokushintsha izinhlangothi nezindlela zokunamathisela ukuthola isibonelo esiphikisayo, bese uchaza ukuthi ubude bomjikelezo buguquka kanjani njengoba uhlangothi olunamathisiwe lufihlwa.
z-m-07-06.material:
Kunamashidi amabili ephepha elinemibala anomumo wonxantathu olungile. Amabili anosayizi nomumo ofanayo ncamashi. Izinhlangothi ezimbili eziseduze ne-engeli elungile zingu-3 cm no-4 cm ubude, futhi uhlangothi olude kakhulu lungu-5 cm. Namathisela amabili ndawonye ezinhlangothini ezilingana ngobude, ncamashi, ngaphandle kwesikhala noma ukugqagqana, ukwenza umumo omusha. Ungaphendula noma uzungezise iphepha ngaphambi kokulinamathisela.
USeoa wathi, 'Uma unamathisela onxantathu abalungile ababili abafanayo ndawonye, kuhlala kuyi-rectangle!'
(3 cm ifundwa 'three centimeters.')

z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani, ayikaze ibe i-rectangle
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Uhlolile ukuthi ngempela akukho ndlela yokunamathisela eyenza i-rectangle? Bheka futhi icala lokunamathisela izinhlangothi ezinde kakhulu.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani, iba i-rectangle
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Lesi yisahlulelo esilandele isitatimende sikaSeoa njengoba sinjalo. Yenza futhi uhlole nawe icala lokunamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-3 cm.

Ngakho kuncike ohlangothini olunamathisiwe nendlela.

Uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezilingana ngobude, ake ubude bohlangothi olunamathisiwe bube ngu-j cm (olunye lwa-3, 4, 5), bese uthola amacala amabili ahlukile lapho ubude bomjikelezo bomumo owenzayo bude kuno-14 cm.

z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ubhale wazi ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele ukuphula 'njalo'?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Akunjalo njalo. Uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-5 cm bese uphendula ucezu olulodwa, uthola i-rectangle ebanzi ngo-3 cm ephakeme ngo-4 cm, kodwa uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-3 cm, akuyona i-rectangle.

z-m-07-10.title: Singasho ini ngezikhwama ezimbili ngemiphumela ekhishwe nguSeoha noHaram?
z-m-07-10.topic: Imiphumela ingahluka ngisho nangaphansi kwemibandela efanayo (ukungenzeka)
z-m-07-10.goal: Yazi ukuthi awukwazi ukuphetha ukuthi izikhwama ezimbili ziyahluka ngemiphumela embalwa yokukhipha okuyi-10, bese usho ukuthi imiphumela isebenza kanjani njengezikhonjo kuze kube kuphi nokuthi ungahlola kanjani kabanzi.
z-m-07-10.material:
Kunezikhwama ezimbili ezinamabula abomvu naluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ahlanganisiwe (Isikhwama 가, Isikhwama 나). Asazi ukuthi kunamabula amangaki esikhwameni ngasinye noma ukuthi izikhwama ezimbili ziyafana noma ziyahluka. USeoha ukhiphe imabula eyodwa esikhwameni 가 noHaram ukhiphe eyodwa esikhwameni 나, babheka umbala wayo bayibuyisela, benza lokhu izikhathi eziyi-10 ngamunye.
Isikhwama 가 (Seoha): obomvu izikhathi ezi-7, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka izikhathi ezi-3
Isikhwama 나 (Haram): obomvu izikhathi ezi-4, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka izikhathi ezi-6
USeoha uthe, 'Isikhwama sami sinobomvu obuningi futhi isikhwama sikaHaram sinoluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka oluningi. Izikhwama ezimbili ziyahluka!'
